verdict.rationale: LangGraph's interrupt() mechanism explicitly lets developers pause graph execution at specific nodes (e.g., before a sensitive tool call) and resume only after external human input via Command, directly enabling approval gating. This is corroborated by GitHub's 'Human-in-the-loop' feature description of inspecting/modifying agent state mid-execution, and community commentary confirms it as a genuine state-machine/HITL capability rather than marketing fluff.
